subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: Should OpenClaw remove full inline systemPromptReport from persisted session entries by splitting durable warning-dedupe state from heavyweight prompt diagnostics?
rationale: The source path is clear, but maintainers need to choose durable diagnostics, warning-dedupe, inactive-session storage, and upgrade semantics before automation changes the session state shape.

options.title: Split Compact State
options.body: Persist only the small state needed across restarts and rebuild, reference, or omit heavyweight diagnostics outside the session index.

options.title: Keep Inline Reports
options.body: Accept the sessions.json size cost until a broader database-first session migration or diagnostics redesign owns the storage shape.

options.title: Rework Skills-Only PR
options.body: Treat the open linked fork PR as partial source work and require it to address systemPromptReport semantics before it can close this issue.

recommendation.title: Split Compact State
recommendation.body: Persist only the small state needed across restarts and rebuild, reference, or omit heavyweight diagnostics outside the session index.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the promptRef mitigation and have the strongest recent history signal for the session-store storage tradeoff.
